topic: Google AI-generated review summaries inside Search ads (US, UK, Australia, India; English; positive only; not editable)

claims.claim: Review summaries are AI-powered summaries of online reviews that appear directly as part of Search ads and highlight positive insights from across the web.

sources.title: Google Ads AI-Generated Review Summaries Help Doc

claims.claim: Google AI automatically aggregates online reviews from across the web to generate the summaries.

sources.title: Google AI writes positive-only review summaries into Search ads in 4 markets

claims.claim: Eligible: Search campaigns, all positions on Google.com, US, AU, UK and IN, in English, all supported devices, all verticals except sensitive categories such as pharmaceuticals.
Advertisers cannot directly edit or customize the generated text, because it represents user feedback.
Google only shows review summaries when it predicts they will improve ad performance.
The help page gives no opt-out or switch-off instructions; it only links to account-level automated asset controls without saying they apply.

Practical takeaway: because Google writes the line from public reviews, the specific words happy customers use now shape the ad. Asking customers to describe exactly what they liked is the lever an advertiser still controls.
claims.notes: Kanishk.Rewires interpretation, not a Google statement.

not_used: Ads in AI Mode in India from 28 Oct 2026: single source, unconfirmed.
July 2026 test disclaimer 'Google AI responses ... can make mistakes': reported from a test, unclear if it applies now.
